text: I can't log into my account after changing my email
expected_response: I can help you regain access. Please verify your identity with the email address previously associated with your account so we can update your login credentials.

text: My password reset link isn't working, it keeps saying expired
expected_response: Password reset links expire after 30 minutes for security purposes. I'll send a fresh reset link to your registered email right away.

text: I got locked out after too many failed login attempts
expected_response: Your account has been temporarily locked as a security precaution. I can unlock it for you now once we verify your identity through a few quick questions.

text: I lost access to my two-factor authentication app and can't sign in
expected_response: I understand how frustrating that is. We can verify your identity using your backup recovery codes or through a manual identity check to restore access.

text: My account was compromised and the attacker changed my password
expected_response: I'm escalating this immediately. I'll lock the account to prevent further unauthorized access and walk you through our identity verification process to restore your ownership.

text: I deleted my account last week but now I want it back, is that possible?
expected_response: Accounts can be recovered within 30 days of deletion. I can initiate the restoration process for you right now, and your data should be fully restored within 24 hours.

text: I was charged twice for my subscription this month
expected_response: I see the duplicate charge on your account. I'll initiate a refund for the extra payment which should appear within 3-5 business days.

text: My invoice shows a charge for a plan I never upgraded to
expected_response: I apologize for the billing discrepancy. Let me review your plan history and correct the charge. If the upgrade was unintentional, I'll process a refund immediately.

text: I cancelled before the renewal date but was still charged
expected_response: I can see the cancellation was processed, and this charge appears to be an error. I'll issue a full refund to your original payment method right away.

text: The promo code said 50% off but I was charged full price
expected_response: I'm sorry the promo code didn't apply correctly. I'll manually apply the 50% discount to your account and adjust the charge on your current invoice.

text: I need an itemized receipt for my company's expense report
expected_response: Absolutely. I'll generate an itemized receipt with full tax details and send it to your registered email. You can also find all past invoices under Billing in your account settings.

text: My payment method was declined even though my card is valid
expected_response: This sometimes happens due to card security checks. Please verify the billing address matches your card issuer's records, or try adding the card again. I can also extend your billing grace period.

text: Is the API down? I've been getting 503 errors for the past hour
expected_response: We're currently experiencing elevated error rates on our API cluster. Our engineering team is actively working on a fix and we expect resolution within the next 30 minutes.

text: The dashboard has been loading incredibly slowly since this morning
expected_response: We've identified a performance degradation affecting the dashboard and have deployed a mitigation. Please try a hard refresh, and let me know if the issue persists.

text: I can't access any of my projects, the page just shows a blank screen
expected_response: There's a known issue affecting the project listing page that our team is actively resolving. As a workaround, try clearing your browser cache or accessing projects directly via their URLs.

text: Our team is seeing intermittent timeouts on all API calls
expected_response: We're aware of intermittent connectivity issues and are scaling up our infrastructure to address the load. You can monitor real-time status at our status page for updates.

text: The file upload feature stopped working about 30 minutes ago
expected_response: Our storage service is currently experiencing issues that affect file uploads. We've identified the root cause and are deploying a fix. I'll notify you as soon as it's resolved.

text: Push notifications haven't been delivering since yesterday evening
expected_response: I can confirm there was a disruption to our notification service starting last evening. It has since been restored, and any queued notifications should be delivering now.

text: It would be great if you could add dark mode to the dashboard
expected_response: Thank you for the suggestion! Dark mode is one of our most-requested features and it's on our product roadmap. I've added your vote to help prioritize it.

text: Can you add an option to export reports as PDF?
expected_response: Great idea! PDF export is something we're planning for an upcoming release. I've logged your request with the product team to help prioritize this feature.

text: I'd love to see Slack integration for real-time notifications
expected_response: We're actively developing third-party integrations and Slack is high on the list. I'll make sure your interest is noted and you'll be among the first to know when it launches.

text: Is there any plan to support bulk user import via CSV?
expected_response: Bulk import via CSV is currently in development and expected to ship next quarter. I've added your request to the feature tracker so you'll be notified when it's available.

text: Would it be possible to add custom fields to the contact form?
expected_response: Custom fields are a popular request and something we're evaluating. I've forwarded your feedback to the product team. In the meantime, you can use our API to extend form functionality.

text: We really need role-based access control for our team workspace
expected_response: Role-based access control is available on our Enterprise plan. If you'd like, I can schedule a call with our sales team to discuss upgrading, or I can share the documentation for the feature.

text: What's the difference between the Pro and Enterprise plans?
expected_response: The Pro plan includes core features for small teams, while Enterprise adds SSO, advanced analytics, dedicated support, and custom SLAs. I can send you a detailed comparison if you'd like.

text: How long does the free trial last?
expected_response: Our free trial lasts 14 days and gives you full access to all Pro features. No credit card is required to start, and you can upgrade or cancel at any time during the trial.

text: Do you have a public API that I can use for integrations?
expected_response: Yes, we offer a comprehensive REST API available on all paid plans. You can find the full documentation and quickstart guides at our developer portal.

text: Is my data stored in the EU or the US?
expected_response: Data residency depends on your account region. EU-based accounts are stored in our Frankfurt data center, and US accounts in Virginia. You can check your region in account settings.

text: Can I use the platform for commercial projects?
expected_response: Absolutely. All paid plans are licensed for commercial use with no restrictions on the number of projects. Please review our terms of service for the full details.

text: What programming languages does your SDK support?
expected_response: Our SDK officially supports Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, and Rust. Community-maintained libraries are also available for Java and Ruby. Check our docs for setup instructions.

text: I just signed up and I'm not sure where to start
expected_response: Welcome aboard! I'd recommend starting with our interactive quickstart guide in the dashboard. It walks you through creating your first project step by step.

text: How do I connect my first data source to the platform?
expected_response: You can add a data source from the Integrations tab in your dashboard. Select your source type, follow the authentication steps, and the connection should be live within a few minutes.

text: Is there a getting-started tutorial or walkthrough video?
expected_response: Yes! We have a series of short video tutorials covering everything from account setup to advanced features. You can find them in our Help Center under the Getting Started section.

text: I'm trying to set up my team but can't figure out how to invite members
expected_response: To invite team members, go to Settings > Team and click Invite. You can enter email addresses and assign roles. Invitations expire after 7 days if not accepted.

text: Where do I find the API keys for my new account?
expected_response: Your API keys are available under Settings > API Keys. You'll see both a publishable key and a secret key. Be sure to store your secret key securely and never expose it in client-side code.

text: Can someone walk me through the initial configuration steps?
expected_response: I'd be happy to help. The three key steps are: create a project, configure your environment variables, and connect a data source. Would you like me to guide you through each one?

text: I want to cancel my subscription effective immediately
expected_response: I can process that for you. Your subscription will be cancelled immediately and you'll retain access through the end of your current billing period. Would you like to proceed?

text: How do I cancel? I can't find the option in settings
expected_response: You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Manage Subscription and clicking Cancel Plan at the bottom. If you'd prefer, I can process the cancellation for you right now.

text: Can I cancel and get a prorated refund for the remaining days?
expected_response: Yes, we offer prorated refunds for annual plans cancelled mid-cycle. For monthly plans, you'll have access through the end of the billing period. I can calculate the exact refund amount for you.

text: I'd like to downgrade to the free plan instead of cancelling entirely
expected_response: That's a great option. I can downgrade you to the free plan which keeps your account and data intact with basic features. The change will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle.

text: If I cancel now, will I lose all my stored data?
expected_response: Your data is retained for 30 days after cancellation, during which you can reactivate and recover everything. After 30 days, data is permanently deleted. I'd recommend exporting your data first.

text: Please cancel my account and delete all associated data
expected_response: I'll process the account cancellation and queue a full data deletion request. Per our policy, data deletion is completed within 30 days. You'll receive a confirmation email once it's finalized.

text: How can I download all the data you have stored about me?
expected_response: You can request a full data export from Settings > Privacy > Export My Data. The export is generated as a ZIP file and typically ready for download within 24 hours.

text: I'd like to submit a GDPR data deletion request
expected_response: I'll initiate a GDPR Article 17 deletion request for your account. All personal data will be erased within 30 days, and you'll receive a confirmation email when the process is complete.

text: What kind of personal data do you collect and how long is it retained?
expected_response: We collect account information, usage analytics, and communication preferences. Data is retained for the duration of your account plus 90 days. Full details are in our privacy policy.

text: Can you confirm that my data isn't being shared with third parties?
expected_response: Your data is not sold or shared with third parties for marketing purposes. We only share data with service providers necessary to operate the platform, as detailed in our privacy policy.

text: I need a copy of your data processing agreement for our legal team
expected_response: Our standard Data Processing Agreement is available for download on our legal resources page. If you need a custom DPA, I can connect you with our legal team to arrange one.

text: How do I opt out of analytics tracking on my account?
expected_response: You can opt out of analytics tracking under Settings > Privacy > Data Collection Preferences. Toggle off the analytics option and the change will take effect immediately.

text: I was charged twice for the same month
expected_response: I can see the duplicate charge on your account. I will initiate a refund for the extra payment right away. It should appear on your statement within 3-5 business days. I apologize for the inconvenience.

text: How do I cancel my subscription?
expected_response: You can cancel your subscription from Account Settings, then Billing, then Cancel Plan. Your access continues until the end of the current billing period. I can walk you through it or handle the cancellation for you right now.

text: I need to update my payment method
expected_response: Go to Account Settings, Billing, Payment Method to update your card. You can add a new card and set it as default, then remove the old one. If your card was declined, updating should retry the charge automatically.

text: I need help with my billing statement
expected_response: I would be happy to help clarify your billing statement. Could you let me know which charge looks unfamiliar? I can look up the transaction details and explain what each line item corresponds to in your plan.

text: Can I downgrade my plan instead of cancelling?
expected_response: Absolutely. You can downgrade anytime from Account Settings, then Plan. The lower rate takes effect at your next billing cycle. You keep all your data; some premium features will become read-only until you upgrade again.

text: I want a refund for this month
expected_response: I can process a refund for the current billing period. Refunds typically appear on your statement within 5-7 business days. Your account will remain active until the end of the paid period. Would you like me to go ahead?

text: My account was locked and I cannot log in
expected_response: Account locks usually happen after multiple failed login attempts for security. I can unlock your account and send a password reset link to your registered email. You should receive it within a few minutes.

text: The website is loading very slowly
expected_response: I apologize for the slowness. Let me check our status page. We are currently experiencing higher than normal traffic which is affecting load times. Our engineering team is scaling up resources. Performance should improve within the next 30 minutes.

text: How do I get started with your platform?
expected_response: Welcome! Start by creating your workspace from the dashboard. Then invite your team members. Our Quick Start guide walks through the key features in about 10 minutes. You can also join our weekly onboarding webinar for a live walkthrough.

text: I would like to request a new feature
expected_response: Thank you for the suggestion! I have added your feature request to our product backlog. Our product team reviews requests weekly and prioritizes based on demand and strategic fit. I will tag your account so you are notified if it gets scheduled.

text: I was charged twice on my last invoice
expected_response: I see the duplicate charge on your latest invoice. I'll process a refund for the extra payment immediately, which should appear on your statement within 3-5 business days.

text: There are two identical charges on my credit card from your service
expected_response: I apologize for the double charge. This appears to be a processing error. I'll issue an immediate refund for the duplicate amount. You should see it reflected in 3-5 business days.

text: My bank shows two deductions for the same subscription
expected_response: I can confirm the duplicate deduction on our end. I've initiated a refund for the second charge. If your bank placed a hold, it should release within 3-5 business days after the refund processes.

text: You billed me twice this month for the same plan
expected_response: I see the duplicate billing on your account and I apologize for the error. I'm processing a refund for the extra charge right now. It will appear on your next statement within 3-5 business days.

text: I see a duplicate payment on my account statement
expected_response: Thank you for bringing this to my attention. I can confirm the duplicate payment and will process a refund immediately. The refund should post to your account within 3-5 business days.

text: I got charged twice for my renewal
expected_response: I see the duplicate renewal charge and I'm sorry for the inconvenience. I'll refund the extra charge now. You'll see it back on your payment method in 3-5 business days.

text: Your payment system double-charged my card
expected_response: I apologize for the payment system error. I've flagged the duplicate charge and am processing a refund right now. The amount will be returned to your card within 3-5 business days.

text: I was overcharged on my latest bill
expected_response: I'll review your latest bill right away. Let me compare the charge against your current plan rate and identify the discrepancy. If there's an overcharge I'll process a correction immediately.

text: The amount charged doesn't match my plan price
expected_response: Let me check that for you. I'll compare the charged amount against your plan's listed price. If there's a mismatch I'll adjust the billing and issue a credit for the difference.

text: I need a refund for the duplicate charge on my account
expected_response: I'll process the refund for the duplicate charge right away. Refunds typically take 3-5 business days to appear on your statement. I'll send you a confirmation email once the refund is submitted.

text: My account says I owe a balance but I already paid
expected_response: Let me look into your payment history. If your payment was received, the balance display may just need time to update. I'll verify the payment and clear any incorrect balance on your account.

text: I want to dispute a charge on my last invoice
expected_response: I understand. Please let me know which charge you'd like to dispute and I'll investigate. If the charge is incorrect, I'll process a refund. If it's valid, I'll explain what it corresponds to.

text: I received a billing notification but my payment method should be up to date
expected_response: Sometimes billing notifications trigger when a card's expiration date passes or the issuing bank flags the transaction. Let me verify your payment method details and retry the charge for you.

text: Can you explain the charges on my bill?
expected_response: Of course. Your bill includes your base plan subscription, plus any add-ons or overages from the billing period. I can walk you through each line item so everything is clear.
